title: chant release list output
description: What `chant release list --json` prints (#4026, ws-104): every release of one member, each the compiled output of one green commit, with its artifact digests, one target per environment, its cuts and the environments that run it. It reads the local chant/lifecycle branch and never fetches. Version 1 of the read contract. Readers ignore fields they do not know; a field is only ever added within a version. The codes are a closed list, each in the one closed list of `reason-codes.ts`. Contract version 1 of this document is written by chant 0.124.28 and newer; the read contract as a whole by chant 0.81.0 and newer.

result.description: Exit code 0, with or without releases.

member.description: The workspace member read, its path of names joined with / when nested, or null for a project outside a workspace (the flat ledger layout).

releases.description: Newest cut first. A release stored with no cut comes last.

reason.description: Null when everything was read. ledger-malformed when some release files or cut lines could not be read; the rest are listed.

releaseDigest.description: computePlanDigest("release", subject) over member, commit, artifactDigests, and each target's env, templates and the name and value of each param. The file is _releases/<releaseDigest>.json on chant/lifecycle, with : written as _.

label.description: The release's label, from its cuts, or null. A label names one release in a member and a release takes at most one label.

commit.description: The full sha of the green commit the release was cut from.

artifactDigests.description: Each image and asset built once from the commit, sorted by component, then path. A config-only release carries the previous release's entries.

targets.description: One per environment the member declares, sorted by env.

cuts.description: Each cut of the release, oldest first.

environments.description: The environments that run the release, sorted by env: in each, the components whose latest deploy record names this release in releaseDigest. A promote with --release writes that field. An environment can run components of several releases.

revoked.description: Added within contract version 1 by #4033, written by chant 0.124.29 and newer. The ci/revoked/<sha> tag on the release's commit, or null when the commit is not revoked. A revoked release is never promoted (chant components promote --release refuses it) and its pending release gates refuse approval. Null too when the ci tags can't be judged, as when ci.green.signedSince names no commit here, which chant workspace check reports.

templates.description: The files the environment's deploys read, compiled for it, sorted by component, then path.

component.description: The component whose deploy reads it, or null for a project with no components.

path.description: The path the deploy step names, relative to the member's directory.

params.description: The resolved build parameters the environment was compiled with, sorted by name. source is outside the release digest.

runOrigin.description: The CI run the cut ran in: the forge (github for GitHub and Forgejo, gitlab), the repo or project, and a link to the run. Null outside CI.

signature.description: Added by #4031, written by chant 0.124.28 and newer. The cut's armored ssh signature (ssh-keygen -Y sign, namespace chant-release) by the actor's key, over the release digest, the label (empty for none), the actor and the timestamp, joined by LF with no final newline. Null for an unsigned cut. A reader checks it against .chant/allowed_signers at base; signatureCheck is chant's own check.

signatureCheck.description: Added within contract version 1 by #4031, written by chant 0.124.28 and newer. Whether signature verifies for actor against the signers file at base and, when the declaration at base names a release gate in identity.gates with a class, whether the role grants in .chant/trust.json at base put actor in it. Judged on every read.

status.description: verified: the signature verifies, and the actor is in the release gate's class when it names one. unsigned: the cut has no signature. unverified: it has one that does not count, and reason says why.

key.description: The fingerprint (SHA256:...) of the key in the signature, or null for an unsigned cut or a signature that can't be read. Reported, never trusted.

revocation.description: A revoked tag on a release's commit (#4033, ws-105), as chant ci list --json shows a commit's revoked tag, with the commit. Read from local tags at read time and judged as release cut judges them: with ci.green.signedSince, a revoked tag without a valid runner statement is ignored and revokes nothing.

commit.description: The release's commit, which the tag names.

tagged.description: When the tag was made, ISO 8601, or null for a lightweight tag.

phase.description: The phase the annotation names as failed, or null when the annotation can't be read.

run.description: The run the annotation names as failed, or null.

id.description: The check run's id, or null for a chant Op run.

opRun.description: Present only when the run is a chant Op run (ci.green.source runs, #4044): its id, the env it is recorded under and the runner whose statement it carries. id above is then null.

signer.description: The runner principal whose statement the tag carries, or null when it counts unsigned.
